newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE rulers re-elect Sheikh Zaid as president.
newsitem.headline: UAE rulers re-elect Sheikh Zaid as president.

text.p: The rulers of the United Arab Emirates seven states on Monday decided to re-elect Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan as president of the oil-rich Gulf Arab state, the official WAM news agency reported.
It quoted Foreign Minister Rashid Abdullah al-Nuaimi as saying the country's Federal Supreme Council (FSC), composed of the rulers of the seven emirates, made the decision in a meeting in Abu Dhabi.
The FSC also decided to re-elect Dubai ruler Sheikh Maktoum bin Rashid al-Maktoum as vice-president, WAM said.
The UAE's head of state, a post held by Abu Dhabi ruler Sheikh Zaid since the federation was formed, is elected by the FSC for a five-year term. His term expires in December.
The UAE on Monday celebrated 25 years of independence from Britain and the 30th anniversary of Sheikh Zaid's accession as ruler of Abu Dhabi.
